notes.title: Full Release!
notes.notes: Thank you so much for all of you that helped us make the game better with your feedback and bug-finding! While Mya is not perfect, we are excited to release it to the world! Luckily we are planning to continue working on any bugs that players find, so please keep letting us know about them! If you've given feedback that hasn't made it in yet (especially bugs), don't fret! We are still working hard on that list of nasty little bugs!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes: We have been busy at work adding some animations and assets into the game! We are aware of issues currently with the visuals regarding quicksand, but please let us know of anything else you find!
